column1: # fuzz/accepted.tsv --- the grammar fuzz findings the owner has accepted.
# Adding a row is the owner's ruling, never a session's (CLAUDE.md). A
# finding a row names is reported "known, accepted (#N)" and does not fail
# a run; every other finding fails as before. A row names the issue that
# records the finding, its grammar, the kinds it is seen as, the
# reproductions that identify it (paths relative to this directory, each
# dominated by one short repeated unit, which is the key), and the
# condition that removes the row. fuzz/accepted/README.md says how a finding
# is matched and what the match cannot tell apart.
